To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

business analytics creates business value by: (1) helping an organization to understand its customers and its market; (2) helping an organization make decisions about how to compete in the market; (3) helping an organization act on those decisions; (4) helping an organization understand its internal operations; and (5) helping an organization manage its operations.

business value from business-analytic investments depends on how well the firm’s business-analytics capabilities are integrated into its decision-making processes and how well it has implemented a business-analytics strategy that includes all the factors identified in the literature.
business analytics contribute to business value by enabling the firm to gain competitive advantage, increase customer value, improve productivity, increase revenue and reduce costs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of why organizations invest in business analytics and how they can get value from their investments.
understanding how business analytics contributes business value and with developing a model that explains how this occurs.
understanding how business analytics contributes business value and how to improve that contribution.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the model is a useful basis for research on the factors that explain how BA capabilities contribute to business value.
this paper provides a model that is a useful basis for understanding how business analytics contributes business value.
the model provides a useful basis for further investigation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the business value of business analytics is a function of the quality of the business-analytics capability, the quality of the data used, the quality of decisions and actions based on the insights, the quality of execution of decisions and actions, and the quality of the environment in which the business analytics are used.
business analytics is an important tool for creating business value.
the business analytics process and success factors are a promising foundation for future research.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the process model provides a useful framework for understanding the value-creation process of business analytics, and the variance model provides a useful basis for understanding how business analytics can contribute to business value.

business value from business analytic is a function of the organization’s ability to use the analyze-insight-action process to create business value and the extent to which the organization’s BA success factors are in place.
the factors in our model are not independent, but interact in complex ways, and that future research needs to take that into account.
